title: Intake mode :chg closes the PR route

story.i_want_to: enroll a repo's intake source in chg mode
story.so_that: the PR route is closed for that repo and loopctl knows the secret and the reviewer root chg uses

rationale: PRD §3 item 3 and §6. The forcing function on loopctl's side, and the registration everything after it reads.

acceptance_criteria.description: Loopctl.Intake.Source.mode accepts :chg beside :pr. A :chg source carries an encrypted change_events_secret (redacted, never cast from a response) and a chg_root_dispatch_id; enrolling or switching to :chg without both is refused 422.
chg_root_dispatch_id must name a parentless, unrevoked, orchestrator-role dispatch of the same tenant, or the write is refused 422 chg_root_invalid.
MergePrecondition refuses any evaluation for a story on a :chg source with 409 change_protocol_enrolled, naming chg submit as the route.
The endpoint specs (operation/2) document the new fields and refusals.

technical_notes: #984 removes :thread from the same enum; whichever lands second resolves the conflict.
Load .claude/skills/chain-of-custody/SKILL.md: chg_root_dispatch_id is a custody input.
